module Features = {
  type point = {
    x: float,
    y: float,
  }
  type options = {
    name: string,
    retries?: float,
    @as("content-type") contentType?: string,
    @as("type") type_: string,
  }
  type nestedInlineB = {
    c: string,
  }
  type nestedInline = {
    a: float,
    b: nestedInlineB,
  }
  type nested = {
    point: point,
    inline: nestedInline,
  }
  type rec box<'t> = {
    value: 't,
    map: 'u. ('t => 'u) => box<'u>,
  }
  type pair<'a, 'b> = {
    first: 'a,
    second: 'b,
  }
  type maybe<'t> = option<'t>
  type direction = [#down | #left | #right | #up]
  type digit = [#0 | #1 | #2]
  @unboxed type size =
    | Number(float)
    | @as("auto") Auto
  @unboxed type stringOrNumber =
    | String(string)
    | Number(float)
  @tag("kind") type shape =
    | @as("circle") Circle({
      radius: float,
    })
    | @as("square") Square({
      size: float,
    })
    | @as("empty") Empty
  @tag("ok") type outcome<'t> =
    | @as(true) Ok({
      value: 't,
    })
    | @as(false) NotOk({
      error: string,
    })
  @tag("type") type byId =
    | @as(1) N1({
      id: float,
    })
    | @as(2) N2({
      name: string,
    })
  @unboxed type oneOrMany =
    | String(string)
    | Array(array<string>)
  type loose = unknown
  @unboxed type rec json =
    | Boolean(bool)
    | String(string)
    | Number(float)
    | Array(array<json>)
    | Object(dict<json>)
    | @as(null) Null
  @unboxed type callback =
    | String(string)
    | Function(unit => unit)
  @unboxed type dateOrText =
    | String(string)
    | Date(Date.t)
  type falsy2 =
    | @as("") Empty
    | @as(0) N0
    | @as(false) False
    | @as(null) Null
  type falsy = option<falsy2>
  type color =
    | @as(0) Red
    | @as(1) Green
    | @as(2) Blue
  type level =
    | @as("low") Low
    | @as("high") High
  type flag =
    | @as(1) A
    | @as(2) B
  type named = {
    name: string,
  }
  type rec employee = {
    salary: float,
    manager?: employee,
    name: string,
  }
  type callable = string => float
  type hybrid = string => float
  type constructable = unknown
  type rec tree = {
    value: float,
    children: array<tree>,
  }
  type partialOptions = {
    name?: string,
    retries?: float,
    @as("content-type") contentType?: string,
    @as("type") type_?: string,
  }
  type pickedPoint = {
    point: point,
  }
  type withoutType = {
    name: string,
    retries?: float,
    @as("content-type") contentType?: string,
  }
  type requiredOptions = {
    name: string,
    retries: float,
    @as("content-type") contentType: string,
    @as("type") type_: string,
  }
  type pointKeys = [#x | #y]
  type pointX = float
  type returned = bool
  type params = (string, float)
  type unwrapped = point
  type nonNull = string
  type getters = {
    getX: unit => float,
    getY: unit => float,
  }
  type eventName = [#onDown | #onLeft | #onRight | #onUp]
  type id = string
  type merged = {
    x: float,
    y: float,
    z: float,
  }
  type autocapitalize = string
  type readyState = [#"and" | #closed | #"in" | #"open" | #"true"]
  type dict2<'t> = dict<option<'t>>
  type ref2<'t> = {
    current: 't,
  }
  @unboxed type refAttributesRef<'t> =
    | Ref2(ref2<Null.t<'t>>)
    | Function(Null.t<'t> => unit)
  type refAttributes<'t> = {
    ref?: refAttributesRef<'t>,
  }
  type findResult = {
    id: string,
  }
  type keyedRecord = {
    a: float,
    b: float,
  }
  type mixedIndex = {
    known: string,
  }
  type inferredObject = {
    host: string,
    port: float,
    tags: array<string>,
  }
  type arrowResult = {
    id: float,
    label: string,
  }
  type rec animal = {
    name: string,
    legs: float,
    speak: (~loud: bool=?) => string,
    shout: string,
    rename: string => animal,
  }
  type rec dog = {
    fetch: string => promise<string>,
    name: string,
    legs: float,
    speak: (~loud: bool=?) => string,
    shout: string,
    rename: string => dog,
  }
  type stack<'t> = {
    push: 't => unit,
    pop: unit => option<'t>,
    size: float,
  }
  type base = {
    id: unit => string,
  }
  /** TypeScript: `Iterable` */
  type iterable
  /** TypeScript: `AsyncIterable` */
  type asyncIterable
  /** TypeScript: `URL` */
  type url
  /** TypeScript: `AbortSignal` */
  type abortSignal
  type fetchLikeInit = {
    signal?: abortSignal,
  }
  /** TypeScript: `Response` */
  type response
  type pickFrom<'t> = {
    items: array<'t>,
  }
  /** TypeScript: `string` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external aString: string = "aString"
  /** TypeScript: `number` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external aNumber: float = "aNumber"
  /** TypeScript: `boolean` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external aBoolean: bool = "aBoolean"
  /** TypeScript: `bigint` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external aBigint: bigint = "aBigint"
  /** TypeScript: `symbol` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external aSymbol: Symbol.t = "aSymbol"
  /** TypeScript: `undefined` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external nothing: unit = "nothing"
  /** TypeScript: `null` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external aNull: Null.t<unknown> = "aNull"
  /** TypeScript: `"hello"` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external literalString: string = "literalString"
  /** TypeScript: `42` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external literalNumber: float = "literalNumber"
  /** TypeScript: `"on"` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external stringLiteralType: string = "stringLiteralType"
  /** TypeScript: `() => void` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external returnsVoid: unit => unit = "returnsVoid"
  /** TypeScript: `string | undefined` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external maybeString: option<string> = "maybeString"
  /** TypeScript: `string | null` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external nullableString: Null.t<string> = "nullableString"
  /** TypeScript: `string | null | undefined` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external nullishString: Nullable.t<string> = "nullishString"
  /** TypeScript: `(id: string) => { id: string; } | undefined` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external find: string => option<findResult> = "find"
  /** TypeScript: `number[]` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external numbers: array<float> = "numbers"
  /** TypeScript: `readonly number[]` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external readonlyNumbers: array<float> = "readonlyNumbers"
  /** TypeScript: `[string, number]` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external pair: (string, float) = "pair"
  /** TypeScript: `readonly [string, number, boolean]` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external triple: (string, float, bool) = "triple"
  /** TypeScript: `[string]` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external single: array<string> = "single"
  /** TypeScript: `[string, (number | undefined)?]` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external optionalTuple: array<unknown> = "optionalTuple"
  /** TypeScript: `[string, ...number[]]` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external restTuple: array<unknown> = "restTuple"
  /** TypeScript: `readonly ["a", 1]` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external constTuple: ([#a], [#1]) = "constTuple"
  /** TypeScript: `{ [key: string]: number; }` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external dictionary: dict<float> = "dictionary"
  /** TypeScript: `Record<string, Point>` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external record: dict<point> = "record"
  /** TypeScript: `Record<"a" | "b", number>` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external keyedRecord: keyedRecord = "keyedRecord"
  /** TypeScript: `{ [key: string]: string; known: string; }` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external mixedIndex: mixedIndex = "mixedIndex"
  /** TypeScript: `{}` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external emptyObject: unknown = "emptyObject"
  /** TypeScript: `object` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external anyObject: unknown = "anyObject"
  /** TypeScript: `{ host: string; port: number; tags: string[]; }` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external inferredObject: inferredObject = "inferredObject"
  /** TypeScript: `(a: string, b: number) => boolean` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external twoArgs: (string, float) => bool = "twoArgs"
  /** TypeScript: `(a: string, b?: number | undefined) => string` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external optionalArg: (string, ~b: float=?) => string = "optionalArg"
  /** TypeScript: `(a: string, b?: number) => number` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external defaultArg: (string, ~b: float=?) => float = "defaultArg"
  /** TypeScript: `(first: string, ...rest: number[]) => void` */
  @module("./features.ts") @variadic
  external restArgs: (string, array<float>) => unit = "restArgs"
  /** TypeScript: `(done: (error: Error | null, value?: string | undefined) => void) => void` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external callback: ((Null.t<JsError.t>, ~value: string=?) => unit) => unit = "callback"
  /** TypeScript: `(f: (...args: number[]) => number) => void` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external restCallback: (array<float> => float) => unit = "restCallback"
  /** TypeScript: `(prefix: string) => (name: string) => string` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external returnsFunction: string => string => string = "returnsFunction"
  /** TypeScript: `{ (value: string): string; (value: number): number; }` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external overloaded: string => string = "overloaded"
  /** TypeScript: `(this: Point, scale: number) => Point` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external withThis: float => point = "withThis"
  /** TypeScript: `(value: unknown) => value is string` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external isString: 'a => bool = "isString"
  /** TypeScript: `(value: unknown) => asserts value is string` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external assertString: 'a => unit = "assertString"
  /** TypeScript: `(id: number) => Promise<{ id: number; label: string; }>` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external arrow: float => promise<arrowResult> = "arrow"
  /** TypeScript: `<T>(value: T) => T` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external identity: 't => 't = "identity"
  /** TypeScript: `<T, U>(items: T[], f: (item: T, index: number) => U) => U[]` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external mapArray: (array<'t>, ('t, float) => 'u) => array<'u> = "mapArray"
  /** TypeScript: `<T extends { id: string; }>(item: T) => T` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external constrained: 't => 't = "constrained"
  /** TypeScript: `<T, K extends keyof T>(item: T, key: K) => T[K]` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external pluck: ('t, 'k) => unknown = "pluck"
  /** TypeScript: `(run: <T>(value: T) => T) => void` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external genericCallback: ('t => 't) => unit = "genericCallback"
  /** TypeScript: `<T>(value: T) => Maybe<T>` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external maybe: 't => maybe<'t> = "maybe"
  /** TypeScript: `(color: Color, level: Level, flag: Flag) => void` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external paint: (color, level, flag) => unit = "paint"
  /** TypeScript: `(color: Color.Red) => void` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external onlyRed: color => unit = "onlyRed"
  module Animal = {
    type t = animal
    /** TypeScript: `typeof Animal` */
    @module("./features.ts") @new
    external make: (string, ~legs: float=?) => animal = "Animal"
    /** TypeScript: `number` */
    @module("./features.ts") @scope("Animal")
    external count: float = "count"
    /** TypeScript: `(name: string) => Animal` */
    @module("./features.ts") @scope("Animal")
    external create: string => animal = "create"
  }
  module Dog = {
    type t = dog
    /** TypeScript: `typeof Dog` */
    @module("./features.ts") @new
    external make: (string, ~legs: float=?) => dog = "Dog"
    /** TypeScript: `number` */
    @module("./features.ts") @scope("Dog")
    external count: float = "count"
    /** TypeScript: `(name: string) => Animal` */
    @module("./features.ts") @scope("Dog")
    external create: string => animal = "create"
  }
  module Stack = {
    type t<'t> = stack<'t>
    /** TypeScript: `typeof Stack` */
    @module("./features.ts") @new
    external make: unit => stack<'t> = "Stack"
  }
  module Base = {
    type t = base
  }
  /** TypeScript: `(animal: Animal) => Dog` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external adopt: animal => dog = "adopt"
  /** TypeScript: `typeof Animal` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external animalClass: unknown = "AnimalClass"
  /** TypeScript: `"text"` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external resolvedConditional: string = "resolvedConditional"
  /** TypeScript: `<T>(value: T) => Conditional<T>` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external deferredConditional: 't => [#other | #text] = "deferredConditional"
  /** TypeScript: `Promise<Point>` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external promise: promise<point> = "promise"
  /** TypeScript: `Map<string, Point>` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external map: Map.t<string, point> = "map"
  /** TypeScript: `Set<number>` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external set: Set.t<float> = "set"
  /** TypeScript: `Date` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external date: Date.t = "date"
  /** TypeScript: `RegExp` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external regexp: RegExp.t = "regexp"
  /** TypeScript: `Error` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external error: JsError.t = "error"
  /** TypeScript: `Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external bytes: Uint8Array.t = "bytes"
  /** TypeScript: `ArrayBuffer` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external buffer: ArrayBuffer.t = "buffer"
  /** TypeScript: `Iterable<number>` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external iterable: iterable = "iterable"
  /** TypeScript: `AsyncIterable<string>` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external asyncIterable: asyncIterable = "asyncIterable"
  /** TypeScript: `URL` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external url: url = "url"
  /** TypeScript: `(input: string, init?: { signal?: AbortSignal | undefined; } | undefined) => Promise<Response>` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external fetchLike: (string, ~init: fetchLikeInit=?) => promise<response> = "fetchLike"
  /** TypeScript: `(value: any) => any` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external takesAny: 'a => unknown = "takesAny"
  /** TypeScript: `(value: unknown) => unknown` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external takesUnknown: 'a => unknown = "takesUnknown"
  /** TypeScript: `(message: string) => never` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external fails: string => 'a = "fails"
  /** TypeScript: `any` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external anyValue: unknown = "anyValue"
  /** TypeScript: `never[]` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external neverArray: array<'a> = "neverArray"
  /** TypeScript: `(args: string[]) => number` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external default: array<string> => float = "default"
  /** TypeScript: `(level?: Level | undefined) => Level | null` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external withLevel: (~level: level=?) => Null.t<level> = "withLevel"
  /** TypeScript: `(mode?: Autocapitalize | undefined) => void` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external capitalize: (~mode: string=?) => unit = "capitalize"
  /** TypeScript: `() => Dict<string>` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external env: unit => dict2<string> = "env"
  /** TypeScript: `<T>(from: { items: T[]; }) => T` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external pick: pickFrom<'t> => 't = "pick"
  /** TypeScript: `() => IterableIterator<[string, number]>` */
  @module("./features.ts")
  external entries: unit => Iterator.t<(string, float), unknown, unknown> = "entries"
}

// Where ReScript says less than TypeScript:
// [union] loose: `Loose`: ReScript cannot tell the members of this union apart at run time
// [callable-object] hybrid: `Hybrid`: the function's properties are dropped
// [constructor] constructable: `Constructable`: a constructor is not a ReScript value; import the class as a module instead
// [intersection] id: `Id`: the brand is dropped; the primitive type is used
// [tuple] single: `[string]`: ReScript has no one-element tuple; an array is used
// [tuple] optionalTuple: `[string, (number | undefined)?]`: tuples with optional or rest elements are imported as arrays
// [tuple] restTuple: `[string, ...number[]]`: tuples with optional or rest elements are imported as arrays
// [index-signature] mixedIndex: `{ [key: string]: string; known: string; }`: the index signature is dropped; only the named properties are imported
// [any-object] emptyObject: `{}`: `{}` accepts any value that is not null or undefined
// [any-object] anyObject: `object`: `object` says nothing about the value's fields
// [rest-in-callback] restCallback (f, args): `number[]`: only an imported function can be variadic; here the rest arguments are one array
// [overloads] overloaded: `{ (value: string): string; (value: number): number; }`: 2 overloads; the first one is imported
// [this-parameter] withThis: `this`: the `this` parameter is dropped
// [constraint] constrained: `T extends { id: string; }`: the constraint is not checked by ReScript
// [constraint] pluck: `K extends keyof T`: the constraint is not checked by ReScript
// [deferred] pluck (result): `T[K]`: the type depends on a type parameter
// [generic-callback] genericCallback (run): `<T>(value: T) => T`: the callback's own type parameters become type parameters of the import, so the callback is checked for one type, not for all
// [value-object] Color: `Color`: the enum's type is imported; its object is not, write the constructors instead
// [value-object] Level: `Level`: the enum's type is imported; its object is not, write the constructors instead
// [value-object] Flag: `Flag`: the enum's type is imported; its object is not, write the constructors instead
// [constructor] animalClass: `typeof Animal`: a constructor is not a ReScript value; import the class as a module instead
// [deferred] deferredConditional (result): `Conditional<T>`: the type depends on a type parameter; its constraint is used
// [any] takesAny (value): `any`: `any` turns checking off; it is imported as `unknown` (or a type variable for an argument)
// [any] takesAny (result): `any`: `any` turns checking off; it is imported as `unknown` (or a type variable for an argument)
// [any] anyValue: `any`: `any` turns checking off; it is imported as `unknown` (or a type variable for an argument)
// [value-object] Util: `Util`: a namespace is not imported; import what it contains from its own module
